Definition: middle voice from G1798; to dream:--dream(-er).
BiblicalUsage: To dream. In the last days old men shall dream dreams, says Joel as Peter quotes him in Acts 2:17 — and Jude warns of filthy dreamers who defile the flesh and despise dominion in Jude 1:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dreams can carry God's Spirit or the flesh's filth, and the difference is whether they lead me to prophesy His word or despise His rule.
RelatedTopics: Dreams; Visions; Outpouring of the Spirit
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; Jude, Brother of James
